# Kadar

> Kadar is a mobile app for amateur football clubs, made by Mastery (Sarajevo, Bosnia and Herzegovina). One phone films the match, puts a live scoreboard and graphics into the picture, and streams it to YouTube or Facebook (one destination at a time) or records it to the phone. Coming to the App Store and Google Play; not released yet.

## What it does

- Scoreboard in the video: score, clock, halves, extra time, penalty shoot-out; eight designs, six positions, four sizes
- Streams to YouTube or Facebook; PRO adds TikTok, Instagram and custom RTMP. One destination at a time
- Records to the phone with the scoreboard in the picture, with or without a stream
- Instant replay in a corner window while the live picture continues, with a caption under it (player, number, club, minute) and a spotlight on a tapped player (PRO)
- Clip studio (PRO): after the match, add a spotlight and a caption to a highlight and export it as a video ready to post
- The spotlight follows one tapped player in one clip. The app does not track the ball and produces no tactics or player statistics
- Automatic highlights: every goal and every marked moment becomes a clip; clips are joined into one reel
- Leagues and cups (PRO): generated schedule, results written into the table, table and bracket as broadcast graphics and as a picture to share. Stored on one phone
- Sponsor pop-ups (PRO): a plate with a sponsor's logo and a line of text rises into a free corner of the picture for 8 seconds, every 2, 5 or 10 minutes or on demand; it never covers the scoreboard, the LIVE sign, a replay or a full-picture slide
- Sponsor logos, sliding text ticker, ad-break slide, prize draw, line-up graphic, scoring from a second phone (PRO)
- Players typed in or read from a photographed team sheet on the device
- Reconnects by itself after a network drop and keeps recording locally meanwhile
- Languages: English, Bosnian, Croatian, Serbian, Slovenian, Macedonian, Albanian

## Limits today

- Live streaming works on iPhone only; Android can record but not stream
- One streaming destination at a time
- Football is the only sport switched on; basketball, handball, futsal, water polo and volleyball are announced as coming soon
- A competition is stored on the phone that created it

## Pricing

- Free: streaming to YouTube or Facebook with the scoreboard, score and clock control, recording, players, highlights, match history
- PRO: planned at €6.99 a month or €49.99 a year with a 7-day free trial; the store price applies
- Launch offer: everything in PRO is free until 28 February 2027

- [How a live stream can bring your club sponsors](https://tarikneradin.github.io/kadar-site/blog/sponsors-for-your-club-live-stream.html): Where a sponsor can appear in a match broadcast, what to offer a local business, and how to show them it worked.
- [Kako prenos uživo može vašem klubu donijeti sponzore](https://tarikneradin.github.io/kadar-site/bs/blog/sponzori-u-prenosu-utakmice.html): Gdje se sponzor može pojaviti u prenosu utakmice, šta ponuditi lokalnoj firmi i kako joj pokazati da se isplatilo.
- [From the final whistle to a post: match highlights for your club's social pages](https://tarikneradin.github.io/kadar-site/blog/match-highlights-for-social-media.html): What to post after a match, in what order, and how to have the clips and the result card ready before you leave the ground.
- [Od posljednjeg zvižduka do objave: highlighti utakmice za stranice vašeg kluba](https://tarikneradin.github.io/kadar-site/bs/blog/highlighti-utakmice-za-drustvene-mreze.html): Šta objaviti poslije utakmice, kojim redom i kako imati isječke i karticu s rezultatom spremne prije nego što napustite teren.
